"""
Data models and typed schemas for videopipeline.
Implements the canonical five-format contract and minimal Creative Production Core
specified in AUTOVIDEO_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION_SPEC_RC4 and AUTOVIDEO_PIPELINE_SPEC_RC3.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any


# â”€â”€ Canonical Source Classes & Format IDs â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class SourceClass(str, Enum):
    """Canonical visual source classes for timeline elements."""
    GENERATED_VIDEO = "GENERATED_VIDEO"
    GENERATED_IMAGE = "GENERATED_IMAGE"
    STOCK_ONLINE = "STOCK_ONLINE"
    ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO = "ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO"


class FormatId(str, Enum):
    """Canonical Five Formats of AutoVideoPipeline."""
    F1 = "F1"  # AI Opening + AI Images
    F2 = "F2"  # AI Opening + Online Stock + AI Video Interleave
    F3 = "F3"  # Full AI Images
    F4 = "F4"  # Reup: Online Background + Original Video Inset
    F5 = "F5"  # Full Custom Video: Online Stock/Custom Footage


class RightsStatus(str, Enum):
    """Usage rights qualification for media assets."""
    ELIGIBLE = "ELIGIBLE"
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"
    DISALLOWED = "DISALLOWED"


class EditorialVerdict(str, Enum):
    """Verdicts emitted by the Stage 3 Editorial QC gate."""
    PASS = "PASS"
    EDIT_READY = "PASS"
    REQUEST_PICKUP = "REQUEST_PICKUP"
    REPLAN = "REPLAN"
    NEEDS_OWNER = "NEEDS_OWNER"


# â”€â”€ Subtitles & Audio â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@dataclass
class SubtitleWord:
    """A single word with syllable duration in centiseconds for ASS \\kf tags."""
    text: str
    duration_cs: int  # Duration in centiseconds (10ms units)


@dataclass
class SubtitleCue:
    """A synchronized subtitle cue containing one or more words."""
    index: int
    start_sec: float
    end_sec: float
    text: str
    words: List[SubtitleWord] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def duration_sec(self) -> float:
        return max(0.0, self.end_sec - self.start_sec)


# â”€â”€ Minimal Creative Production Core (Story, Character, World, Shot) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@dataclass
class NarrationSpan:
    """A bounded segment of narration audio and transcript."""
    start_sec: float
    end_sec: float
    text: str
    cue_indices: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class Beat:
    """A dramatic narrative beat inside a scene."""
    beat_id: str
    narration_span: NarrationSpan
    dramatic_function: str
    active_characters: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    emotional_tone: str = "neutral"
    is_major: bool = True


@dataclass
class Scene:
    """A cohesive narrative unit bounded by location, time, and dramatic goal."""
    scene_id: str
    scene_index: int
    start_sec: float
    end_sec: float
    location_id: str
    time_context: str
    active_characters: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    dramatic_goal: str = ""
    story_state: str = ""


@dataclass
class Event:
    """A specific narrative occurrence with causal dependencies."""
    event_id: str
    event_type: str
    description: str
    causal_dependencies: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class LookState:
    """A character's physical appearance in a specific scene/phase."""
    character_id: str
    outfit: str
    physical_state: str  # e.g., "healthy", "injured", "disheveled"
    expression: str      # e.g., "defiant", "fearful", "composed"


@dataclass
class CharacterReference:
    """A versioned canonical image reference for character visual consistency."""
    character_id: str
    image_path: Path
    version: str
    fingerprint: str
    is_canonical: bool = True


@dataclass
class Character:
    """A recurring story character with persistent DNA and look states."""
    character_id: str
    name: str
    canonical_dna: str = ""
    look_state: Optional[LookState] = None
    reference_fingerprint: str = ""
    reference_version: str = "v1.0"


@dataclass
class Location:
    """A story environment anchor with persistent atmosphere."""
    location_id: str
    name: str
    location_dna: str
    environment_type: str = "interior"


@dataclass
class Prop:
    """A narrative prop with explicit owner, location, and condition state."""
    prop_id: str
    name: str
    prop_dna: str
    owner_character_id: Optional[str] = None
    location_id: Optional[str] = None
    state: str = "intact"  # e.g. intact, damaged, drawn, holstered, confiscated


@dataclass
class WorldState:
    """
    Observable physical and narrative state carrying character conditions,
    prop ownership/location, environment state, and narrative knowledge.
    """
    character_states: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    prop_states: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    location_states: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    narrative_knowledge: Dict[str, List[str]] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class VisualRequirement:
    """Concrete visual criteria compiled for a shot."""
    required_visuals: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    forbidden_visuals: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    continuity_from_previous: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    preferred_source_class: SourceClass = SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE
    stock_search_intent: str = ""
    character_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class ShotSpec:
    """
    A single visual shot specification binding story action, entry/exit state,
    and visual requirements.
    """
    shot_id: str
    scene_id: str
    duration_sec: float
    shot_type: str = "medium"
    camera_motion: str = "slow push-in"
    primary_subject: str = ""
    primary_action: str = ""
    entry_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    action_or_event: Optional[str] = None
    exit_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    continuity_from: Optional[str] = None
    continuity_to: Optional[str] = None
    visual_requirement: Optional[VisualRequirement] = None
    reference_character_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)


# â”€â”€ Profiles & Format Plans â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@dataclass
class EffectProfile:
    """Resolved composition and atmospheric effect settings."""
    profile_id: str = "default_cinematic"
    waveform_enabled: bool = True
    snow_overlay_enabled: bool = True
    grain_enabled: bool = False
    vignette_enabled: bool = True
    karaoke_subtitles_enabled: bool = True
    z_order: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {
        "base": 0,
        "atmosphere": 10,
        "hud": 20,
        "subtitles": 30
    })
    safe_margins: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {
        "top": 40,
        "bottom": 60,
        "left": 60,
        "right": 60
    })
    mask_atmospheric_from_subtitles: bool = True
    fingerprint: str = ""

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.fingerprint:
            raw = f"{self.profile_id}_{self.waveform_enabled}_{self.snow_overlay_enabled}_{self.grain_enabled}_{self.vignette_enabled}"
"""
Async web server backend for videopipeline Studio using aiohttp.
Zero external dependencies beyond aiohttp.
"""
import os
import sys
import subprocess

if sys.stdout:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
if sys.stderr:
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

import json
import asyncio
import re
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional

from aiohttp import web

from ..config import BASE_DIR, GOOGLE_FLOW_COOKIE_PATH
from ..clip_registry import get_registry_stats, filter_unused, record_clips
from ..stages.stage1_ingest.srt_parser import parse_srt_file
from ..stages.stage1_ingest.scene_planner import plan_story_scenes
from ..stages.stage2_assets.stock_manager import StockManager
from ..stages.stage2_assets.veo_client import GoogleFlowVeoClient
from ..stages.stage2_assets.flow_generator import check_cookie_expiry
from ..stages.stage2_assets.online_stock import PexelsClient
from ..stages.stage3_compose.timeline_builder import TimelineBuilder
from ..stages.stage3_compose.ass_karaoke import generate_karaoke_ass
from ..stages.stage4_render.nvenc_engine import NvencRenderEngine
from ..stages.stage4_render.qa_verifier import QAVerifier
from ..doctor import SystemDoctor
from ..process_manager import process_manager
from ..clip_cleaner import purge_story_raw_clips, calculate_purgeable_stats
from ..workspace_cleaner import clean_story_workspace

def get_story_stock_dirs(story_dir: Path) -> List[Path]:
    """Discovers story-specific custom stock and standard project stock pools."""
    dirs = [
        story_dir / "custom_stock",
        story_dir / "custom_videos",
        story_dir / "stock",
        BASE_DIR / "AutoVideoPipeline" / "story2_exclusive_stock",
        BASE_DIR / "AutoVideoPipeline" / "story2_curated_stock",
        BASE_DIR / "AutoVideoPipeline" / "stock_proxy",
        BASE_DIR / "AutoVideoPipeline" / "cache",
        BASE_DIR / "assets" / "stock"
    ]
    return [d for d in dirs if d.exists()]

STATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "static"

# In-memory log buffer for real-time console streaming
LOG_BUFFER: List[str] = []

def log_event(msg: str):
    """Appends a log line to buffer and prints to console."""
    LOG_BUFFER.append(msg)
    if len(LOG_BUFFER) > 500:
        LOG_BUFFER.pop(0)
    print(f"[Studio] {msg}")

def check_story_dir(item: Path) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if not item.is_dir() or item.name.startswith((".", "__")):
        return None
    audios = list(item.glob("*.m4a")) + list(item.glob("*.mp3")) + list(item.glob("*.wav"))
    srts = list(item.glob("*.srt"))
    if audios and srts:
        master_video = item / "Final_Video_Export" / "Full_Master_Video_26M.mp4"
        veo_dir = item / "veo_clips"
        veo_count = len(list(veo_dir.glob("shot_*.mp4"))) if veo_dir.exists() else 0
        return {
            "name": item.name,
            "path": str(item.resolve()),
            "audio_file": audios[0].name,
            "srt_file": srts[0].name,
            "has_master": master_video.exists(),
            "master_size": master_video.stat().st_size if master_video.exists() else 0,
            "veo_clip_count": veo_count
        }
    return None

def discover_stories(base_dir: Path) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Discovers all valid story directories in base_dir (including category folders)."""
    stories = []
    ignore_names = ("AutoVideoPipeline", "api_keys", "assets", "docs", "tools", "videopipeline")
    for item in base_dir.iterdir():
        if not item.is_dir() or item.name.startswith((".", "__")) or item.name in ignore_names:
            continue
        # Check direct folder
        s = check_story_dir(item)
        if s:
            stories.append(s)
        else:
            # Check 1 level of subdirectories inside category folders
            try:
                for sub in item.iterdir():
                    sub_s = check_story_dir(sub)
                    if sub_s:
                        stories.append(sub_s)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return sorted(stories, key=lambda s: s["name"])

async def handle_index(request):
    """Serves the main SPA index.html."""
    index_file = STATIC_DIR / "index.html"
    return web.FileResponse(index_file)

async def handle_get_stories(request):
    """Returns discovered stories list."""
    stories = discover_stories(BASE_DIR)
    return web.json_response({"status": "ok", "stories": stories})

async def handle_get_story_details(request):
    """Returns detailed metadata for a specific story folder."""
    dir_str = request.query.get("dir", "")
    if not dir_str:

    # Allow picking specific audio or SRT file

    req_srt = request.query.get("srt", "")

    chosen_audio = next((a for a in audios if a.name == req_audio), audios[0])
    chosen_srt = next((s for s in srts if s.name == req_srt), srts[0])

    # Parse SRT
    cues = parse_srt_file(chosen_srt)
    total_dur = cues[-1].end_sec if cues else 0.0
    plan = plan_story_scenes(total_dur, cues)

    # Stock & Veo

    # Master Video

    has_master = master_path.exists()
    master_info = {}
    if has_master:
        master_info = {
            "size_bytes": master_path.stat().st_size,
            "path": str(master_path.resolve()),
            "name": master_path.name
        }

    # QA previews
    previews_dir = story_dir / "Final_Video_Export" / "previews_v2"
    previews = []
    if previews_dir.exists():
        for img in sorted(previews_dir.glob("*.jpg")):
            previews.append({
                "name": img.name,
                "path": str(img.resolve()),
                "size": img.stat().st_size
            })

    # Schedule if exists
    sched_file = story_dir / "fast_pipeline" / "video_schedule.json"
    schedule_data = {}
    if sched_file.exists():
        try:
            with open(sched_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                schedule_data = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            pass

    audio_list = []
    for a in audios:
        try:
            sz = a.stat().st_size
        except Exception:
            sz = 0
        audio_list.append({"name": a.name, "path": str(a.resolve()), "size": sz})

    srt_list = []
    for s in srts:
        try:
            sz = s.stat().st_size
        except Exception:
            sz = 0
        srt_list.append({"name": s.name, "path": str(s.resolve()), "size": sz})

    return web.json_response({
        "status": "ok",
        "story_name": story_dir.name,
        "story_path": str(story_dir.resolve()),
        "audio": {
            "name": chosen_audio.name,
            "path": str(chosen_audio.resolve()),

        "audio_files": audio_list,
        "subtitles": {
            "name": chosen_srt.name,
            "cue_count": len(cues),

                for c in cues[:10]

        },

        "plan": plan,
        "assets": {
            "stock_count": stock_mgr.unused_count,
            "stock_total": stock_mgr.total_count,
            "stock_files": [{"name": p.name, "path": str(p.resolve())} for p in stock_mgr.get_unused_pool()[:12]],
            "veo_count": len(veo_clips),
            "veo_files": [{"name": p.name, "path": str(p.resolve())} for p in veo_clips],
            "cookie_valid": val_cookie.get("valid", False),
            "registry": reg_stats
        },
        "master_video": master_info,
        "qa_previews": previews,
        "schedule": schedule_data
    })

item.text:
Implemented F5 stock proposal compilation in [online_stock.py](/D:/CADS-Benchmark/XP-002-AUTO/arms/N1/videopipeline/stages/stage2_assets/online_stock.py) and added offline fake-provider coverage in [test_stock_proposals.py](/D:/CADS-Benchmark/XP-002-AUTO/arms/N1/tests/test_stock_proposals.py).

The compiler returns one review-only row per supplied shot, builds its search intent from shot meaning and visual requirements, and includes candidate identity, preview reference, fit score, and explicit no-match or search-failure status. Shortlists are capped at five; candidates with negligible semantic fit are filtered out. It does not download or assign footage.

Checks run: `python -m pytest tests/test_stock_proposals.py tests/test_stock_constraints.py -q` — **7 passed**. Fake-provider tests observed distinct shot searches, filtering of unsuitable candidates, bounded results, preview references, and explicit provider failure without external services.

Limitation: the compiler returns a structured table, but this change does not add a Studio UI or endpoint to display it. Candidate ranking uses the retriever’s existing metadata-based semantic scoring. No material Owner preference or authority decision was needed.
